svg.title: Red Breach - Freight Access paper route, discussion draft 02

g.text: PAPER ROUTE 02 | Level 2-3 candidate | Detours, locks and a knowledge shortcut
Quiet arrival > learn the plant > freight card + power > lift departure
Retractable ladder in A4; fixed descent in B4
Door 1 stays locked. Take the red side passage
around it to the junction at 2. The annex is a side room.
Door 2 blocks entry to Security Dispatch. Turn left
into Records and head north to the supervisor room.
R opens door 2. Return to that junction and continue.
The separate freight card K waits in A4, at the fork.
B2 > B3 leads to the closed east face of door 4.
Backtrack; the red service route reaches its release.
Once opened from the west, it stays open both ways.
Only one selection stays active. Initial state: all off.
Sparks / faulty circuit. Both useful routes closed.
Deploy A4 ladder + open Maintenance passage.
Open the local health hatch. Close BcD again.
Matching codes are the clue, not a remote announcement.
GMa > BcD > Tr1 leaves the secret open, ladder closed.
Knowing players can collect health, then reselect BcD.
BcD links A4 and B4 through an upper service tunnel.
Collect K in A4, then choose the long return or BcD.
A5/A6 return to the hub; Maintenance leads to Power.
K + P are always required. No button can block completion.
Agree these connections, then plan enemies and supplies.
The Tr1 health secret is reserved; its amount is undecided.
TRAVEL CHECK / WALK 5 m/s, SPRINT 8 m/s
Known ordinary route: 1,956 m / 6.52 min walking
BcD knowledge route: 1,314 m / 4.38 min walking
Probing both blocked approaches adds about 390 m / 78 seconds walking.
These are drawn centrelines, not playtest times; ladder travel, combat and searching are excluded.
~10-minute familiar-run target remains unproven. B2/B3 become optional on the efficient red route.
Discussion draft 02 / preserves the main footprint. Health-secret location proposed; no enemy pass or 3D construction yet.
